author: JuicyCoconut
quote: Charging full price for a pretty coat of paint over a 28-year-old game is just pure greed at this point.Yeah, they added a jump button and fixed the camera, cool. Everything else still plays like a clunky 1998 game: empty overworld, tedious backtracking, and braindead puzzles. Worse, they actually cut content like Master Quest and stuck us with one save slot. And don't even get me started on the new voice acting, which completely kills the lonely, eerie vibe of the original with generic anime-tier dialogue.Literally just boot up the 3DS version or play it on NSO. Paying €70 for this is a joke.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: JuicyCoconut
quote:
Worth every single second of the 13-year wait. Rockstar actually pulled it off. What makes this an easy 10/10 is how they took the heavy physics, realistic weight, and insane level of detail from Red Dead Redemption 2 and dropped it straight into modern day Vice City. Leonida feels genuinely alive & NPCs actually act like real people, and you can easily lose hours just cruising around soaking in the vibe. Jason and Lucia are easily Rockstar's best characters since Arthur Morgan, and that was a tough bar to clear. Their story hits with that same RDR2 emotional gut-punch, making every heist and quiet moment actually matter instead of just being mindless chaos. Throw in way smoother gunplay and incredible driving, and it's hands down the best game ever made. 
Ignore the 0/10 review bombers some people are just miserable and hate seeing others enjoy something great. Go play it.
